Please don't go back in until they say it is safe. We are arranging a Gas Safe registered engineer to attend as an emergency, with a same-day target, and we'll update you once we have a time. The oven not heating will be looked at as part of that visit. Please don't use the previous settings advice any more. We'll be in touch again today.
